name: Yamaha YM1 305
engine: 305 cc air-cooled two-stroke parallel twin, Autolube oil injection
intro: A bigger version of the YDS twin with Autolube oil injection. Uncommon and collectible.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
